Name: Pearl's Hair from Splatoon 2
Author: Kvoor
Description:
Introducing a mod no one asked for:
[b][size=3]PEARL FROM SPLATOON 2![/size][/b]
I have a colored version and a black and white version together or separate for download.

--------Installation Instructions--------
1.) Download the file
2.) Go to file destination (If you use Steam) " C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer "
3.) Make a[b] [u]backup[/u][/b] of Hairstyles.xnb by copying and pasting it in another location (I suggest dedicating a folder to original files)
4.) Copy and paste the modified Hairstyles.xnb into the file where the original was (I also suggest keeping original mod files, but I'm just weird)
5.) Load game and test

Note: This has [u]not[/u] replaced any hairstyles, this adds on to what's already there so no worries if you love all the vanilla hairstyles.

If you have other hairstyle mods and would like to use them in conjunction with this one then feel free to merge mine with the other if you know how, you have my permission.

I don't know who's in love with Splatoon 2/Pearl enough to have the hairstyle but hey, if people like it I might make the outfit to go with it.

[size=3]Enjoy!
[/size]**Feel free to share this with other sites, just credit me if you would, this took me longer than it should to make**
